name: researchbridge-mvp
description: ResearchBridge MVP demo — dependency-free static web app. No build step.

scripts.checksums: find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS.txt ! -name .DS_Store ! -path './node_modules/*' -exec shasum -a 256 {} + | sed 's|\./||' | sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS.txt && echo 'SHA256SUMS.txt regenerated'
